items.title: Live TV
items.text: Channels and sports from your live addons, with Favorites and Recent.

items.title: Trakt
items.text: What you watch tracked, watched marks, Continue Watching and Trakt rows on Home. Bring your own Client ID.

items.title: Seek previews
items.text: A picture of the film on the seek bar as you move through it, for debrid and direct links.

items.title: Chapters
items.text: The film's chapters on the seek bar and in the seek pill. Settings › Seek bar.

items.title: Tracks per show
items.text: The subtitles and audio you pick stay for the whole show.

items.title: Subtitles your way
items.text: 20 fonts for Latin and Arabic, brightness, position and forced-only subtitles, set while you watch.

items.title: Film collections
items.text: On the title page, in Search and in the Library.

items.title: No spoilers
items.text: Episodes you haven't watched: their pictures blurred, their stories hidden too if you like. Settings › Appearance.
